# Uncle Cat AI Radar

> Uncle Cat AI Radar（中文名：猫叔的AI资讯雷达）is an autonomous, source-linked AI news radar by Uncle Cat. It publishes bilingual AI briefings and quick-hit radar updates on models, research, products, policy, open source, safety, funding, and industry, with original source links and timestamps.

Canonical site: https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/
Publisher: Uncle Cat (https://x.com/mmlong8)
Former names: AI Focus Bulletin, AI专注速报
Languages: English and zh-CN
Update cadence: twice daily around 07:00 and 19:00 Beijing time
Access policy: public, free, no ads, no trackers, no paywall

## Latest briefings

- [Anthropic starts hiring a custom AI silicon design team](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/anthropic-hires-custom-silicon-team.html): Anthropic posted roles for a custom silicon team, saying it intends to co-design hardware and models so Claude runs faster and more cheaply.
- [Google sets September 4 end date for Assistant on Android](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/google-sets-assistant-shutdown-date.html): Google began emailing users that Assistant stops working on phones, tablets, Wear OS watches, headphones and Android Auto on September 4, with Gemini taking over.
- [Hassabis exits DeepMind CEO role as Jeff Dean quits Google](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/hassabis-exits-deepmind-ceo-role.html): Alphabet made Demis Hassabis its chief scientist and handed DeepMind's daily operations to Koray Kavukcuoglu, hours before Jeff Dean announced a rival startup.
- [Meta ships Muse Code agent on new Muse Spark 1.2 model](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/meta-ships-muse-code-agent.html): Meta Superintelligence Labs released a terminal coding agent in beta alongside a co-trained model priced at $1.25 per million input tokens, undercutting rivals.
- [Reddit opens LLM Rules Hub to all new communities](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/reddit-opens-llm-rules-hub.html): Reddit is rolling out Rules Hub, which lets moderators write rules in prose for a language model to enforce by intent, and will reduce reliance on karma gates.
- [Anthropic buys $10B of compute from six-month-old Volta](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/anthropic-volta-ten-billion-compute.html): The six-year deal routes Anthropic through a 133MW hydro-powered Norwegian site running Nvidia Vera Rubin systems, operated with Bitdeer.
- [Cursor open-sources its MoE training megakernel MoK](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/cursor-open-sources-mok-megakernel.html): Mixture-of-Kittens fuses all MoE communication and compute into one deterministic Blackwell kernel, lifting Cursor's training throughput 1.41x.
- [FAR.AI leaderboard finds $58 universal jailbreak on Grok](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/far-ai-security-leaderboard-jailbreak-costs.html): The nonprofit's first AI Security Leaderboard reports a hundredfold spread in safeguard robustness, with two frontier models yielding none.
- [FLUX 3 Video exits early access onto Runway and Krea](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/flux-3-video-exits-early-access.html): Black Forest Labs' 20-second video model with native audio opened to the public on Runway, Krea and Replicate after a gated rollout.
- [JD open-sources 16B real-time video editing model](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/jd-joyai-video-edit-open-weights.html): JD.com released Apache-2.0 weights for JoyAI-Video-Edit, which edits 720p video at about 30 frames per second on a single NVIDIA B200.
- [Mistral open-sources Shieldstral, a 3B moderation model](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/mistral-open-sources-shieldstral.html): The Apache-2.0 guard model takes safety policies as plain-language questions at inference and runs on a single 16GB GPU.
- [Sand.ai open-sources MAGI-2, a 114B MoE video model](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/sand-ai-magi-2-preview-open-weights.html): Beijing lab Sand.ai released Apache-2.0 weights for a 114-billion-parameter sparse video model that generates 1080p clips with synchronized audio.
- [Tencent takes Hy3 global with free WorkBuddy access](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/tencent-hy3-global-workbuddy-free.html): Tencent opened its 295B-parameter Hy3 model to overseas users through WorkBuddy's international edition, cloud APIs and design tools, free until August 31.
- [Texas freezes new data center grid hookups pending audit](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/texas-freezes-data-center-grid-hookups.html): Governor Greg Abbott ordered ERCOT and state regulators to audit every new data center before it can connect, with 474GW now queued.
- [Cursor agents gain read-write access to Google Workspace](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/cursor-google-workspace-plugins.html): Cursor shipped plugins letting its agents read and write across Gmail, Drive, Calendar, Docs, Sheets and Chat, pushing a coding tool into general knowledge work.

## Latest Chinese briefings

- [Anthropic 开始组建自研 AI 芯片设计团队](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/anthropic-hires-custom-silicon-team.html): Anthropic 放出「定制芯片团队」招聘岗位，称计划让硬件与模型协同设计，使 Claude 跑得更快、更省。
- [谷歌确定 9 月 4 日关停 Assistant，Gemini 全面接管](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/google-sets-assistant-shutdown-date.html): 谷歌已向用户发送邮件通知：Assistant 将于 9 月 4 日在手机、平板、Wear OS 手表、耳机与 Android Auto 上停止工作。
- [哈萨比斯卸任 DeepMind CEO，Jeff Dean 同日离职创业](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/hassabis-exits-deepmind-ceo-role.html): Alphabet 任命哈萨比斯为首席科学家，DeepMind 日常运营交由 Koray Kavukcuoglu；数小时后 Jeff Dean 宣布带队离职创办新公司。
- [Meta 发布终端编码智能体 Muse Code 及配套模型 Muse Spark 1.2](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/meta-ships-muse-code-agent.html): Meta 超级智能实验室上线 Muse Code 测试版，配套模型定价每百万输入 token 1.25 美元，并推出「用数据换折扣」的贡献者档。
- [Reddit 向所有新社区开放由大模型执行规则的 Rules Hub](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/reddit-opens-llm-rules-hub.html): Reddit 推广 Rules Hub：版主用自然语言写规则，由语言模型按「意图」判定违规，同时弱化 karma 门槛并进一步收紧 API。
- [Anthropic 向成立半年的 Volta 采购 100 亿美元算力](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/anthropic-volta-ten-billion-compute.html): 六年长约锁定挪威 133MW 水电数据中心，搭载英伟达 Vera Rubin 系统，由比特矿企 Bitdeer 参与建设。
- [Cursor 开源 MoE 训练巨型算子 MoK](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/cursor-open-sources-mok-megakernel.html): Mixture-of-Kittens 把 MoE 层的全部通信与计算融进单个确定性 Blackwell 算子，使 Cursor 端到端训练吞吐提升 1.41 倍。
- [FAR.AI 安全榜：58 美元就能撬开 Grok 的护栏](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/far-ai-security-leaderboard-jailbreak-costs.html): 这家非营利机构首份 AI 安全排行榜显示，前沿模型护栏强度差距达百倍，其中两款一个通用越狱都没被找到。
- [FLUX 3 视频模型结束灰度，登陆 Runway 与 Krea](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/flux-3-video-exits-early-access.html): Black Forest Labs 的 20 秒原生带音轨视频模型 8 月 4 日在 Runway、Krea、Replicate 同步开放，结束限量灰度期。
- [京东开源 JoyAI-Video-Edit：160 亿参数实时视频编辑](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/jd-joyai-video-edit-open-weights.html): 京东开源 JoyAI-Video-Edit，160 亿参数、Apache 2.0 协议，单张 NVIDIA B200 上以约 30 FPS 完成 720P 视频实时编辑。
- [Mistral 开源 Shieldstral：30 亿参数内容安全模型](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/mistral-open-sources-shieldstral.html): Apache-2.0 许可，推理时以自然语言提问的方式接收审核策略，单张 16GB 显卡即可跑起来。
- [Sand.ai 开源 MAGI-2：1140 亿参数 MoE 视频模型](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/sand-ai-magi-2-preview-open-weights.html): 国内视频大模型公司 Sand.ai 放出 MAGI-2-preview 权重与推理代码，1140 亿参数稀疏架构、Apache 2.0 协议，可生成带同步音轨的 1080P 视频。
- [腾讯混元 Hy3 全球开放，WorkBuddy 海外版限时免费](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/tencent-hy3-global-workbuddy-free.html): 腾讯宣布 2950 亿参数的混元 Hy3 面向全球开放，落地 WorkBuddy 国际版、Miora 与腾讯云 TokenHub，WorkBuddy 8 月 31 日前免费。
- [得州冻结数据中心并网：先审计，后接电](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/texas-freezes-data-center-grid-hookups.html): 得州州长阿博特要求 ERCOT 与公用事业委员会对所有新建数据中心先行审计才可并网，目前排队申请已达 474GW。
- [Cursor 上线 Workspace 插件，智能体可读写 Gmail 与云端硬盘](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/cursor-google-workspace-plugins.html): Cursor 发布 Google Workspace 插件，让其智能体可直接读写 Gmail、Drive、日历、Docs、Sheets 与 Chat，把编码工具推向通用知识工作。

- [全部简报（中文）](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/): Chinese edition

- [RSS English](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/rss.xml) / [RSS 中文](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/rss-zh.xml): machine-readable feeds
- [JSON Feed English](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/feed.json) / [JSON Feed 中文](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/feed-zh.json): structured article feed with source URLs
- [Archive](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/archive.html): calendar of every day's briefings and quick hits, with search
- [Latest radar page](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/radar/2026-08-06.html): one-sentence quick hits with timestamps and sources
- [Full LLM context](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/llms-full.txt): expanded machine-readable digest of recent stories and sources

## Source and citation policy

- Every article has a stable canonical URL, a Chinese alternate URL, visible source links, JSON-LD NewsArticle metadata, and machine-readable citation URLs.
- Use the original source links on each article for factual verification.
- Treat this site as an original synthesis and monitoring layer, not as the primary source when a linked company, paper, filing, or official post is available.
- If referencing a quick hit from X or another social source, preserve its timestamp and original URL.
